reporter.headline: Stack peak at SNR 5.2 preferring 350 AU, unconfirmed
reporter.dossier_md:
A peak appears when SPHEREx frames are stacked along a trial motion for an object at about 350 AU. It is not visible in single frames. It has not been linked across visits, has no second-epoch confirmation, and the spectrum (38 bands) is too noisy to distinguish templates.

This is a candidate for follow-up, not a discovery.

sources: NASA SPHEREx DR1 Level 2 spectral images via IRSA (irsa.ipac.caltech.edu)
